close_reason: Fixed in commit 1b073f4. Added CONTACT_UPDATE_ALLOWED projection ("blocked", "displayName" per draft §ChatContact/set line 878) to contact.rs handle_contact_set update branch. Non-allowed fields silently dropped before reaching backend.update_object; patches carrying only non-allowed fields yield invalidPatch. Three new integration tests cover allowed-only, all-rejected, and mixed-patch paths with spec-text oracles. Pattern mirrors existing SpaceBan/set allowlist convention (ban.rs:236-263). The MAINTENANCE invariant on the CONTACT_READONLY/CONTACT_UPDATE_ALLOWED lists is the same hand-maintained pattern tracked workspace-wide under JMAP-x2gd.87.
description:
Site: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/contact.rs:152-218 (handle_contact_set update branch).

draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §ChatContact/set (line 878): 'update supports: blocked, displayName.'

The handler:
- rejects patches that contain {id, firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt} via CONTACT_READONLY (line 156)
- but then converts the WHOLE remaining patch_val into a PatchObject (line 173) without any whitelist

A client can patch arbitrary fields: lastSeenAt would be rejected (it's read-only) but login, presence, lastActiveAt, status, and any other field flows through to backend.update_object. The MemoryBackend's update_object applies the RFC 7396 merge patch with no further filtering.

This is the inverse of how SpaceBan/set handles the same problem (ban.rs:234-247: BAN_UPDATE_ALLOWED whitelist, only retained fields land in the cleaned patch). The ChatContact handler should mirror that pattern with const CONTACT_UPDATE_ALLOWED = &["blocked", "displayName"].

Trigger: a client sends update {"contactId": {"presence": "online"}}. Spec says clients cannot patch presence (it's server-derived). The handler accepts it; the MemoryBackend stores it; subsequent ChatContact/get returns the client-supplied value. In production this corrupts presence state and lets clients forge other users' presence indicators.
title: ChatContact/set update accepts arbitrary fields; spec restricts to {blocked, displayName}
